narrative.overview: The user confirmed this direction and authorized direct implementation. A steady navy navigation rail frames a light, practical workspace. Traditional Chinese copy makes the next action clear; restrained blue accents and readable progress information support everyday project coordination.
keyCharacteristics: Precise time geometry and complete report labels

rules.name: The Action Color Rule
rules.body: Use blue to clarify interaction and purple for completion; avoid green in all new design unless the user explicitly allows it. This requirement takes precedence over older wording in `.impeccable/design.json`.

rules.name: The File Guidelines Reading Rule
rules.body: The `file-guidelines-*` typography roles apply only to the file-collaboration guidance surface; they do not replace the incumbent title/body/label roles. Section headings use the scoped heading role, paragraphs and rule descriptions use the scoped body role, and field labels and desktop textareas use the scoped field role. Rule titles retain their scoped weight and size on desktop and mobile. At the surface's narrow breakpoint, paragraphs and descriptions use the mobile body role and textareas use the mobile textarea role. Filename examples use the scoped monospace role so extensions and version suffixes stay distinguishable. Desktop textareas use a 1.8 line-height; field labels use weight 600. Descriptions are limited to 70ch and long text wraps rather than clipping.

rules.name: The Directory Reading Rule
rules.body: Drive paragraphs reuse the existing file-guidelines body measurements (14px, 1.85 line-height, 70ch maximum), and narrow-screen paragraphs reuse its mobile body measurements (15px, 1.85 line-height). These are compatible scoped roles, not changes to the global body default. Directory headings are 18px; breadcrumbs and file names are 14px, table headers and result status are 13px. Table cells use a 1.7 line-height, updated times use tabular numerals, and long file names wrap. Mobile search uses the existing readable input treatment (16px); selects retain the inherited workspace font and native controls.

rules.name: The Contained Directory Rule
rules.body: The Drive table retains a 720px minimum width inside its own horizontal scroll container; the workspace itself must still fit the viewport. The first column receives 38% of the table width. Connection actions, breadcrumbs, controls and result status wrap. At 650px and below, search takes a full row, the two readable selects share the next row, and connection actions use the full available width. Keep the remaining table columns accessible by horizontal scrolling instead of compressing file names, timestamps and preview links.

rules.name: The Temporary Notice Rule
rules.body: The notice is held only in component memory and resets to the blank template when the page is exited or reloaded. It is not an autosaved draft or a backend operation. Clipboard actions report their result in a polite status region and disable while copying; failure exposes selectable rule text or directs the reader to select the existing notice manually. Keep the scope note that cloud permissions and versions are managed by the original storage service. This page neither uploads files nor sends group messages.

rules.name: The Directory Session Rule
rules.body: Drive OAuth access tokens and directory metadata stay in component memory only. The account/group-keyed component remount isolates sessions when either identity changes; leaving the directory, reload or local disconnect clears its connection state. Disconnect does not revoke the Google OAuth grant. The feature requests metadata read-only access, then queries the configured project folder and entered children; the grant itself is broader than that folder. File and image links open Google Drive. This directory does not copy, download, upload or delete Drive content.

dos: Do keep Traditional Chinese copy, keyboard focus, written status labels, empty/error/loading states, and existing role-dependent functions.
Do check both 900px navigation behavior and 600px content reflow when adding screens.
Do preserve internal timeline/calendar scrolling, long-text wrapping, and readable mobile fields.
Do keep Drive filters and same-version image matching explicitly limited to loaded metadata, with the table scroll contained on mobile.
Do keep precise time geometry and complete report labels when changing the Gantt; tick density must not alter task duration.
donts: Don't reintroduce slogans or motivational filler in functional headings.
Don't turn every metric into an elevated card or add decorative gradients and scale effects to this flat workspace.
Don't hide demo labeling or claim live integration validation from sample data.
Don't treat visual documentation as authorization to alter data schemas, permissions, or saved task colors.
